cited.quote: In the Government order fifth read above, the Government have further enhanced the Ulema Pension from Rs.1000/- to Rs.1500/-Per month.

rationale: C1 (2020 GO) recounts that the fifth GO read, G.O.(Ms) No,57 of the Backward Classes department, enhanced Ulema Pension from Rs.1000/- to Rs.1500/- per month, exactly the promised increase. Its date is OCR-garbled but the year reads 2016, after the May 2016 start, so only the year is given. Other extracts concern general pensions.
